issues.description: torch.cuda.set_device crashes when --local_rank default None is used under env-var launchers
issues.detail: args.local_rank defaults to None and is passed directly to torch.cuda.set_device before deepspeed.init_distributed. Modern deepspeed/torchrun launchers set LOCAL_RANK via env var rather than the CLI flag, so this raises TypeError immediately. Fall back to int(os.environ.get('LOCAL_RANK', 0)) or require the arg.

issues.description: trainer_args key mismatch: docstring says max_steps/val_interval but code reads max_step and ignores val_interval
issues.detail: The docstring documents max_steps and val_interval, but __init__ reads trainer_args['max_step'] and never references val_interval. Validation cadence is instead silently bound to save_interval, and configs following the documented schema will KeyError. Reconcile keys and honor val_interval and log_interval.

issues.description: Run loop can overshoot max_step, save unaligned/duplicate checkpoints, or loop forever when training does not advance
issues.detail: run() loops while global_step < max_step and unconditionally calls train()/save/valid each iteration. The inner train() runs save_interval batches without checking max_step, so the final iteration overshoots; if the iterator exhausts without advancing global_step, the same step is saved repeatedly. Add per-batch max_step guard and a no-progress break.

issues.description: Checkpoint auto-resume silently picks latest local checkpoint, masking missing --resume_path and fragile sort
issues.detail: Because (output_dir/'checkpoints').mkdir runs in __init__, the resume fallback always activates. A user-supplied resume_path that doesn't exist silently falls through to glob/sort the latest step_* directory, masking user error. The sort key int(name.split('step_')[-1]) also crashes on any non-numeric suffix. Require explicit opt-in and use a stricter regex.

issues.description: Validation averaging is unweighted and inconsistent across ranks with uneven shards
issues.detail: valid() takes a simple mean of per-batch averaged stats, which is unweighted by batch/token count and biased when batches differ. Per-rank DistributedSampler shards may also have different lengths, so the post-loop mean is computed over different N per rank, yielding inconsistent global metrics. Weight by sample/token count and reduce counts across ranks.

issues.description: CLI flag naming mixes hyphens and underscores inconsistently
issues.detail: Most user-facing flags use hyphens (--train-config, --output-dir) but --local_rank and --resume_path use underscores. argparse handles both via attribute dest, but the surface is inconsistent and breaks shell completion conventions. Standardize on hyphens for user-facing flags.

synthesis.summary: The PR adds a DeepSpeed-based trainer and launcher for SpeechLM. The panel unanimously flags two P0s: torch.cuda.set_device(args.local_rank) crashes when launchers use the LOCAL_RANK env var instead of --local_rank, and there is a docstring/code mismatch where trainer_args is documented as max_steps/val_interval but the code reads max_step and never uses val_interval. Secondary concerns center on the run/save loop (overshoot, possible repeated saves, no-progress loops), checkpoint auto-resume silently masking user error with fragile sorting, and validation metric aggregation that is unweighted and inconsistent across ranks. CLI naming consistency is a minor cleanup. These should be resolved before merge.
